item.title: Pilot · Weekly call #2 · right before Devcon 8
item.description: 1h37 of musicians, stewards and friends across India, the US and Thailand — the sanctuary, continuous flow, India × the West, the cultural floor, sound check, stewards and the jam. Recorded 27 October 2026 · 16:06 UTC with consent asked out loud; first names only. Recorded with everyone's consent, asked out loud on the recording itself (00:06, confirmed 00:35 and 01:02). Everyone named in the transcript consented to this recording being public. Still a proposal, not an on-chain DAO. CC BY-SA 4.0.

item.title: Episode 1 · The First Circle
item.description: Shaka opens the first proposal circle after Devcon 8 with Ben, Levi and Utkarsh: how a no-commission orchestra might one day fund flights, housing and a shared backline retroactively and equally, from EthCC in Cannes to Devcon 9 in Lisbon. Levi describes his co-op’s approach to rights and revenue splits, Utkarsh’s x402 agent-tipping work is recapped, and the circle agrees only to keep talking — the DAO stays a proposal, in Shaka’s words “just a prayer.” Recorded 12 November 2026 · 17:36 UTC · 00:36 Bangkok with consent asked out loud; first names only. Recorded with everyone's consent to publish: full consent for this recording to be broadcast and shared everywhere, confirmed by Shaka Lei Kaumaka on 13 November 2026 (05:21 UTC). Still a proposal, not an on-chain DAO. CC BY-SA 4.0.

item.title: Episode 2 · The Second Circle
item.description: Shaka hosts Aakaash, Sha and Vipul: no token for OSO, gift first and receipts after, a European backline for the road to Lisbon, a Devcon 9 song, copyright care — and a tour of this very hall. Recorded 13 November 2026 · 07:11 UTC · 14:11 Bangkok with consent asked out loud; first names only. Recorded with everyone's consent to publish — participants gave a thumbs-up to recording at the opening — confirmed by Shaka Lei Kaumaka on 14 November 2026 (04:20 UTC). Still a proposal, not an on-chain DAO. CC BY-SA 4.0.
